We can’t confirm a lower price yet because any discount requires human review, and no discount has been approved. We also don’t have a confirmed restock date yet, but we’ll follow up once we have one.

Would you like us to hold the 8 available hoodies while we check on the restock, or would you prefer another option?

Campus Customs Customer Service
